description: Vitals, medications, allergies, problems and plan items from one sentence of a dictated clinical note. Numbers arrive as tags (bp_1, rate_1, spo2_1, temp_1, dose_1, freq_1); copy tags, never digits.

tools.name: record_vital
tools.description: Record one vital sign measured today. value_tag is the tag that holds the number, such as bp_1 or rate_1.

kind.description: BP blood pressure, HR heart rate or pulse, RR respiratory rate, SpO2 oxygen saturation, temp temperature

value_tag.description: The tag holding the value, e.g. bp_1

tools.name: add_medication
tools.description: Record one medication the patient takes, was started on, stopped, or that is being considered.

dose_tag.description: The tag holding the dose, e.g. dose_1

route.description: PO by mouth, IV intravenous, IM intramuscular, SC subcutaneous, SL sublingual

frequency_tag.description: The tag holding how often, e.g. freq_1

status.description: taking = already on it; started = begun today; stopped = discontinued; considering = maybe later

tools.name: add_allergy
tools.description: Record a drug or other allergy and the reaction it causes.

substance.description: What the patient is allergic to

reaction.description: The reaction, e.g. rash or hives

tools.name: add_problem
tools.description: Record a diagnosis, symptom or medical history item.

text.description: The problem in a few words

tools.name: add_plan_item
tools.description: Record one step of the plan: a test, referral, follow-up or instruction.

text.description: The plan step in a few words

tools.name: none
tools.description: The sentence holds nothing to record.
